mediaWork.title: Amanda Knox
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The case of Amanda Knox, an American student accused, convicted, and ultimately exonerated for the 2007 murder of her roommate Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy. Explores the intense media scrutiny, controversial evidence, and complexities of the Italian justice system.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Twice convicted and twice acquitted by Italian courts for the 2007 murder of her British roommate Meredith Kercher, Amanda Knox became the subject of global speculation as non-stop media attention fed the public's fascination.

Knox reflecting on being seen as either a "psychopath in sheep's clothing" or "you."

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Amanda Knox was convicted of the murder of Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy, in 2009. Her conviction was overturned in 2011, reinstated in 2014, and definitively overturned in 2015. She spent nearly 4 years in prison before her final exoneration.
